en.headline: Saudel moves inland over eastern Guangdong; Signal No. 1 remains
en.dek: At 1pm Tropical Storm Saudel was about 330 km northeast of Hong Kong and is forecast to move west across inland areas while weakening gradually.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory said the Standby Signal No. 1 remained in force on Thursday afternoon as Tropical Storm Saudel continued to affect the region.

At 1 p.m., Saudel was estimated near 24.3 degrees north, 116.6 degrees east, about 330 kilometres northeast of Hong Kong. It was forecast to move west at about 12 kilometres per hour across the inland areas of eastern Guangdong and weaken gradually.

The Observatory noted that the combined influence of Saudel and the northeast monsoon would keep local winds occasionally strong offshore and on high ground. Members of the public were advised to stay updated with the latest weather information.

zh.headline: 沙德爾移入廣東東部內陸 一號戒備信號維持
zh.dek: 下午1時熱帶風暴沙德爾位於本港東北約330公里，預料向西橫過廣東東部內陸並逐漸減弱。
body: 香港天文台表示，一號戒備信號於周四下午繼續生效，熱帶風暴沙德爾仍影響華南沿岸。
下午1時，沙德爾估計位於北緯24.3度、東經116.6度附近，即香港東北約330公里，預料以時速約12公里向西移動，橫過廣東東部內陸，並逐漸減弱。
天文台指，受沙德爾與東北季候風共同影響，本港離岸及高地間中吹強風。市民應繼續留意天文台的最新天氣消息。
